label: The EDM denoiser and its loss

spec.title: The denoiser, its loss, and what it learns
spec.caption: EDM notation (Karras et al. 2022). Data at σ = 0; σ is the standard deviation of the added noise.
spec.main_latex: D_\theta(x, \sigma \mid c) = c_\text{skip}(\sigma)\, x + c_\text{out}(\sigma)\, F_\theta\big(c_\text{in}(\sigma)\, x,\ c_\text{noise}(\sigma) \mid c\big)

steps.explanation: Corrupt a data sample x₀ with Gaussian noise of standard deviation σ.
Train the denoiser to recover x₀ from x_σ, at every noise level at once.

steps.latex: D^\star(x, \sigma \mid c) = \mathbb E\big[x_0 \mid x_\sigma = x,\ c\big]
steps.explanation: The minimiser of a squared error is a conditional mean: the optimal denoiser returns the average of all clean samples consistent with x.
Tweedie's formula: the denoiser gives the score of the noised distribution, which is all a sampler needs.
Preconditioning keeps the network's input and its training target at unit variance for every σ. AlphaFold 3 uses exactly this with σ_data = 16 Å.
